statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains in the low band while macro, geopolitical and FOMC stress remain extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; the principal conditional checkpoints are the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster, the cash open and the multi-stage FOMC sequence.
headline: Tail remains low as cross-assets stay conflicted ahead of an extreme-stress FOMC day
body: Fresh evidence is mixed rather than one-way: the U.S. 10-year yield remains near 5%, Brent is near $108, delayed NQ context is modestly firmer, and latest-session megacap weakness conflicts with semiconductor strength. Live NQ retracement structure is not independently verified, so Tail remains low.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 17% to 23%. WATCH dominated several pre-open and U.S. session windows on September 15 while Stress stayed 95-99%; Tail returned to the low band after the cash session and remained low overnight.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail stays low through most of the European morning, rises to WATCH around the 12:30 UTC U.S. data and cash open, and peaks at 24% during the 17:45-20:15 UTC FOMC danger window. Any higher band requires observed persistent one-way structure, failed retracements or a credible delayed second leg.
